text: Make the heading row A1:Q1 Bold, give it Yellow fill colour and apply Wrap Text.

Columns K (Total), L (Percentage) and M (Result) are already filled in for you (grey cells). In column N (Grade) using nested IF give grade on Percentage: 75 or more = "A", 60 or more = "B", 40 or more = "C", below 40 = "D".
In column O (Selection) using IF with AND write "Selected" if the Total is 160 or more AND Typing Speed is 25 WPM or more, otherwise "Not Selected".
In column P (Scholarship) using IF with OR write "Yes" if a student got 90 or more in Hindi OR 90 or more in Computer, otherwise "No".
In column Q (Hostel) using IF write "Hostel" if the District is not Jaipur, otherwise "Day Scholar". Use the not equal to (<>) sign.
Using COUNTIF, in cell T4 count the students whose Result is "PASS", and in cell T5 count the girl students (Gender = "F").
Using COUNTIF with signs, count in T6 the students with Typing Speed 35 or more (>=35), in T7 the students with Computer marks below 40 (<40), and in T8 the students not from Jaipur (<>).
Using COUNTIFS (more than one condition), count in T9 the girls (F) whose Result is PASS, and in T10 the OBC students from Kota district.
In cell T11 find the average Total (column K) of the students of Jodhpur district using AVERAGEIF, rounded to 2 decimal places with ROUND.
Apply All Borders to the complete table A1:Q201.
Apply AutoFit Column Width to the columns A to Q.
Freeze the Top Row of the sheet, and apply Filter to the complete table A1:Q201.
Center align the Gender column C2:C201.
Give the sheet tab a Green Tab Color, and rename the sheet Sheet1 to "Students".
Apply Percentage Number Format with 2 decimal places to the Percentage column L2:L201.
